messages.author: 964993c75887caa8
messages.subject: Formative construct with equal weights
parts:
Hi again,

Is this specification of a formative construct with equal weights correct?

IC <~ 1*EMO + 1*VIT + 1*COG + 1*slowstandsw1 + 1*visimpw1 + 1*hearimpw1

Thank you,

Ángel

messages.author: f1530326ce101401
messages.subject: Re: Formative construct with equal weights
parts:
Hi Angel,

I am not very experienced with this, but my answer would be no. The syntax you provide is a reflective construct with equal weights. If you want to model IC as a formative construct, my suggestion would be to just take a sum score of your indicators. 

Best wishes,

Jasper

messages.author: 964993c75887caa8
messages.subject: Re: Formative construct with equal weights
parts:
Dear Jasper,

Thank you for your answer.

The symbols to define a reflective construct are =~. According to the
description of the package lavaan (p. 83), <~ would be the way to
indicate a formative construct.

I think your proposal of adding the indicators would be a valid alternative.

Best,

Ángel
